Legal Clinic · For Attorneys

Join the Equality Ohio Attorney Referral Network

Expand your reach and expertise with the Equality Ohio Legal Clinic Attorney Referral Network. Share your expertise, learn from others, champion equal access to the law with Equality Ohio.

Why Join

What network membership offers

Connect with regional attorneys

Join a community of Ohio attorneys working with the Legal Clinic — share your expertise and learn from others across the state.

Enhance your LGBTQ+ knowledge

Access exclusive Continuing Legal Education (CLE) opportunities and deepen your knowledge of the law as it affects LGBTQ+ Ohioans.

Take vetted referrals

Network members take vetted referrals from the clinic in their practice area and county — at whatever volume works for you.

Join the Network

Need legal help, rather than offering it?

The Legal Clinic’s services are always free for LGBTQ+ Ohioans. Start a confidential intake, or call 855‑LGBT‑LAW.

About the Legal Clinic

Ohio’s statewide LGBTQ+ advocacy and legal aid organization — working toward an Ohio where justice, dignity, and self-determination belong to everyone.
